content.heading: Ideas become a graph
content.body: Square brackets name a neighbour. Follow the link — do not scroll hunting.

slides.notes: Ideas earn power when they point at each other.

content.heading: Bracket references
content.body: Same-file targets resolve forward and back.

slides.notes: Follow the link — you are navigating a graph, not scrolling a document.

content.heading: Wikilinks with an alias
content.body: Alias is for reading. The target is still the idea name.

slides.notes: Double-bracket wikilinks are familiar if you use tools like Obsidian.

content.heading: Try this
content.body: Add account_model and link both ways once.

slides.notes: Optional: peek the local graph if it is already discoverable.
